messages.text: Hi, just sent my RMA, back, and emailed a copy of the tracking information.  I have been reading online that the BSB NerdQaxe++ Rev6.1, has been having a lot of issues.  Can we exchange it for something different, I am willing to pay extra for a better product with more TH?
Searched the catalog · bitcoin miner TH/s
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe Harlo B30 K-Box miner

Thanks for sending it back, and for the tracking.

Once it reaches the warehouse, RMA processing takes up to 10 days. Putting that toward a bigger miner and paying the difference is doable, but a person on the team has to set that up, I can't move money on an RMA myself.

In stock now: NerdQX, 8 TH/s, $299.99. Jingle Hashcard, 12.5 TH/s, $559. GekkoScience KBOX, 22 TH/s at 330 W, $800.

What's your order number and the email on it?

Found it. The NerdQaxe++ shows delivered Aug 14, so the upgrade against your RMA is the team's once the unit reaches the warehouse.

Separately, the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 on that order still hasn't shipped and I have no date for it. Sorry about that. I can swap that line now for more TH and you pay the difference: NerdQX, 8 TH/s, $299.99, or the GekkoScience KBOX, 22 TH/s, $800.

My flag to a manager didn't go through, so please also email (email hidden) with the order number. Want either swap?

Good pick. The Magic Miner 40T is $799, 40 TH/s and tunable 30 to 50. It's pre-sale, Batch 5, shipping November 14. 26 units left in that batch.

I can't run that swap from here, your order is marked shipped so it has to go through the RMA team. They confirm how the returned $249 NerdQaxe++ applies against the $799 once it lands.

Email (email hidden) with Shop···· and say you want the 40T. Want me to check anything else on the order?
Is the nerdQX + Hammer DC06 bundle in stock?
Searched the catalog · NerdQX Hammer DC06 bundle

Honest answer, I'd skip that one. The NerdQX half is fine, but the Hammer DC06 is oversold and past its ship window, and I don't have a date for it I'd stand behind. Every DC06 bundle is in the same spot right now.

On its own the NerdQX is $299.99 and in stock. The Magic Miner 40T is $799, Batch 5, shipping November 14.

The team is on now too, if you want a person in this chat. Which way are you leaning?
Waiting for an answer from Abel, about my RMA, my name is Raland S.

Thanks Raland. I can't see Abel's queue or his messages from here, and my attempt to flag this to the team just failed again, twice now. I'm sorry, that's on us.

Fastest route: reply on your existing RMA email thread with Abel, or email (email hidden) with Shop···· and the return tracking, and say you want the Magic Miner 40T at $799 against the credit. That puts it in front of a person with everything they need.

Anything else I can check on the order meanwhile?
